```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(knitr)

data_file <- "../data/processed/data.csv"
coagent_file <- "../data/processed/data_coagent.csv"

data <- read.csv(data_file, na.strings = "", check.names = FALSE)
data_coagent <- read.csv(coagent_file, na.strings = "", check.names = FALSE)
key_columns <- c("iso", "year")

stopifnot(all(key_columns %in% names(data)),
          all(key_columns %in% names(data_coagent)))

duplicate_keys <- function(x) {
  x |> count(across(all_of(key_columns))) |> filter(n > 1)
}

format_columns <- function(x) {
  if (length(x) == 0) "None" else paste(x, collapse = ", ")
}
```

## Dataset overview

```{r}
#| label: overview

overview <- bind_rows(
  tibble(
    dataset = "data.csv",
    rows = nrow(data),
    columns = ncol(data),
    unique_country_years = nrow(distinct(data, across(all_of(key_columns)))),
    duplicate_country_years = nrow(duplicate_keys(data))
  ),
  tibble(
    dataset = "data_coagent.csv",
    rows = nrow(data_coagent),
    columns = ncol(data_coagent),
    unique_country_years = nrow(distinct(data_coagent, across(all_of(key_columns)))),
    duplicate_country_years = nrow(duplicate_keys(data_coagent))
  )
)

kable(overview)
```

## Variables

```{r}
#| label: variable-comparison

data_only <- setdiff(names(data), names(data_coagent))
coagent_only <- setdiff(names(data_coagent), names(data))
shared_columns <- intersect(names(data), names(data_coagent))
shared_value_columns <- setdiff(shared_columns, key_columns)

# Variables with the same meaning but different names in the two files.
renamed_column_matches <- tribble(
  ~data_column, ~coagent_column,
  "Drought", "drought",
  "Earthquake", "earthquake",
  "conflict", "conflict_lag1",
   "matmor", "maternal_mortality",
   "infmor", "infant_mortality",
   "neomor", "neonatal_mortality",
   "un5mor", "under5_mortality"
)

comparison_map <- bind_rows(
  tibble(
    data_column = shared_value_columns,
    coagent_column = shared_value_columns
  ),
  renamed_column_matches
)

variable_comparison <- bind_rows(
  tibble(dataset = "data.csv only", variable = data_only),
  tibble(dataset = "data_coagent.csv only", variable = coagent_only),
  tibble(dataset = "Shared", variable = shared_columns)
)

kable(variable_comparison)
```

`data.csv` only contains: `r format_columns(data_only)`.

`data_coagent.csv` only contains: `r format_columns(coagent_only)`.

The following differently named variables are compared as equivalent fields:

```{r}
#| label: renamed-variable-matches

kable(renamed_column_matches)
```

## Country-year coverage

```{r}
#| label: key-comparison

data_keys <- distinct(data, across(all_of(key_columns)))
coagent_keys <- distinct(data_coagent, across(all_of(key_columns)))

keys_only_in_data <- anti_join(data_keys, coagent_keys, by = key_columns)
keys_only_in_coagent <- anti_join(coagent_keys, data_keys, by = key_columns)

key_comparison <- tibble(
  comparison = c("Country-years only in data.csv",
                 "Country-years only in data_coagent.csv",
                 "Country-years shared by both files"),
  n = c(nrow(keys_only_in_data), nrow(keys_only_in_coagent),
        nrow(inner_join(data_keys, coagent_keys, by = key_columns)))
)

kable(key_comparison)
```

## Shared covariate values

The following table compares missingness and values for common columns as well
as the explicitly mapped renamed variables. It excludes the `iso` and `year`
keys. A value difference is counted only when both files have non-missing values
and the numeric values differ.

```{r}
#| label: shared-values

joined_data <- inner_join(
  data |>
    select(all_of(c(key_columns, comparison_map$data_column))) |>
    rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_data"), all_of(comparison_map$data_column)),
  data_coagent |>
    select(all_of(c(key_columns, comparison_map$coagent_column))) |>
    rename_with(
      ~ paste0(.x, "_coagent"),
      all_of(comparison_map$coagent_column)
    ),
  by = key_columns
)

value_comparison <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(comparison_map)), function(i) {
  data_column <- comparison_map$data_column[i]
  coagent_column <- comparison_map$coagent_column[i]
  data_value <- joined_data[[paste0(data_column, "_data")]]
  coagent_value <- joined_data[[paste0(coagent_column, "_coagent")]]
  same_value <- (is.na(data_value) & is.na(coagent_value)) |
    (!is.na(data_value) & !is.na(coagent_value) &
       dplyr::near(data_value, coagent_value))

  tibble(
    data_column = data_column,
    coagent_column = coagent_column,
    missing_in_data = sum(is.na(data_value)),
    missing_in_coagent = sum(is.na(coagent_value)),
    values_different = sum(!same_value)
  )
}) |> bind_rows()

kable(value_comparison)
```

```{r}
#| label: value-difference-details

mismatch_details <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(comparison_map)), function(i) {
  data_column <- comparison_map$data_column[i]
  coagent_column <- comparison_map$coagent_column[i]
  data_value <- joined_data[[paste0(data_column, "_data")]]
  coagent_value <- joined_data[[paste0(coagent_column, "_coagent")]]
  differs <- !(is.na(data_value) & is.na(coagent_value)) &
    (is.na(data_value) | is.na(coagent_value) |
       !dplyr::near(data_value, coagent_value))

  tibble(
    iso = joined_data$iso[differs],
    year = joined_data$year[differs],
    data_column = data_column,
    coagent_column = coagent_column,
    data_value = data_value[differs],
    coagent_value = coagent_value[differs]
  )
}) |> bind_rows()

if (nrow(mismatch_details) == 0) {
  cat("All non-missing shared covariate values are identical.")
} else {
  kable(head(mismatch_details, 20),
        caption = "First 20 differences in shared covariates")
}
```
